invalid.name: wrong version
invalid.why: v must be 1

invalid.name: unknown field
invalid.why: additionalProperties is false on the envelope

invalid.name: unknown kind
invalid.why: kind is one of the ten kinds

invalid.name: seq zero
invalid.why: seq is 1-based

invalid.name: author with a space
invalid.why: an identity has no whitespace

invalid.name: author that is a bare user:
invalid.why: user: alone names nobody

invalid.name: author starting with @
invalid.why: @role is an addressee form, never an author

invalid.name: to with an upper-case role
invalid.why: a role is a lowercase slug

invalid.name: reply_to zero
invalid.why: reply_to names a seq, which is 1-based

invalid.name: request without to
invalid.why: a request without an owner is a note

invalid.name: request without shape
invalid.why: a request needs a shape: header line

invalid.name: shape after a blank line is body text, not a header
invalid.why: the header block ends at the first blank line

invalid.name: blocked without missing
invalid.why: a blocked needs a missing: header line

invalid.name: blocked with an empty missing
invalid.why: `-`, `none`, `n/a` are not a reason

invalid.name: decision by an agent
invalid.why: only user:* posts a decision

invalid.name: task row by an agent
invalid.why: task rows are the board's own log

invalid.name: headers that do not match the body
invalid.why: headers is derived from body

invalid.name: citations that do not match the body
invalid.why: citations is derived from body

invalid.name: citation line zero
invalid.why: a cited line is 1-based

invalid.name: card not addressed to the user
invalid.why: a card is a request to user:*

invalid.why: mode is ask, plan or write

invalid.name: empty topic
invalid.why: topic is a non-empty string

invalid.name: body that is not a string
invalid.why: body is text

invalid.name: author with a trailing newline
